PR: Validate kubernetes resource name before applying XR [closed]
### Description of your changes
This PR validates that a composed resource from a function has a valid kubernetes resource name. By doing this, we prevent the `resourceRefs` of being populated with an invalid name in the first place, as they are created before applying the resource.
https://github.com/twobiers/crossplane/blob/5a84b21de7f65fb55c12e3a978ceaecf72d2365a/internal/controller/apiextensions/composite/composition_functions.go#L471-L480

Fixes #6534
